title: Zulay Kitchen Professional Cheese Grater Stainless Steel - Durable Rust-Proof Metal Lemon Zester Grater With Handle - Flat Handheld Grater For Cheese, Chocolate, Spices, And More - Black
description:
About this item
PREMIUM QUALITY, VERSATILE GRATER: Made with high-quality 18/10 rust-resistant stainless steel, this cheese grater has a strong and sturdy frame that can handle pressure without getting bent. Apart from cheese, this small grater can be used for ginger, garlic, nutmeg, chocolate, citrus fruits, butter, and vegetables like carrots, potatoes, zucchini, and more.
GRATE WITH EASE & SAVE TIME: Our parmesan cheese grater is made with razor-sharp etched stainless steel blades for enjoying finely grated cheese effortlessly. Sprinkle some flavor over a salad, pizza, pasta, a bowl of soup or use it as a citrus zester for adding a tangy twist to your recipes.
ERGONOMICALLY DESIGNED: Our handheld cheese grater is designed with a soft thermoplastic rubber handle for a non-slip, comfortable grip. The raised support frame allows it to be set on a solid surface for more control.
EASY TO CLEAN & STORE: Unlike a box grater, our flat cheese grater can be easily cleaned in the dishwasher or by running it through water. It comes with a hanging hole for convenient storage.
HASSLE-FREE, ZULAY GUARANTEE: We are a family owned USA business that believes in providing customers with the best quality products. Our cheese grater with handle is backed with a lifetime warranty.
